enonce_intro_markdown:
**SECTION D: ESSAY**

*Write an essay of about 200-250 words on any ONE of the following topics.*

questions.enonce_markdown: **1.** Girls make better leaders than boys. Discuss.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un sujet en « Discuss » attend un développement équilibré : présenter des arguments en faveur de l'affirmation, des arguments qui la nuancent ou la contredisent, puis une prise de position personnelle en conclusion, jamais un unique point de vue défendu sans contrepartie.

Structure retenue : introduction (présentation du débat, annonce du plan), un paragraphe d'arguments en faveur de l'idée, un paragraphe qui la nuance, une conclusion qui tranche personnellement. Voici un modèle de 220 mots environ.

**Introduction.** Whether girls make better leaders than boys is a subject that divides opinion in every society. While some believe leadership has nothing to do with gender, others argue that girls display qualities that make them more effective leaders. This essay examines both sides before giving a personal opinion.

**Arguments in favour.** Girls are often said to be more patient and better listeners than boys, two qualities essential to good leadership. A leader who listens carefully to the members of a group before deciding is more likely to make fair decisions and to carry everyone along. Girls are also generally considered more organised and more careful with details, which helps them plan and follow up tasks more effectively than a leader who acts impulsively.

**Nuance.** However, leadership skills are not determined by gender but by a person's character, training and experience. History and everyday life show many examples of excellent male leaders as well as poor female ones, and the reverse. Reducing leadership quality to being a girl or a boy risks ignoring the individual qualities that truly make a good leader, such as honesty, courage and the ability to make difficult decisions.

**Conclusion.** In my opinion, no gender is inherently a better leader than the other. What truly determines good leadership is the individual's character and preparation, not whether that person is a girl or a boy.

### Conseil
Sur un sujet « Discuss », ne saute jamais le paragraphe de nuance : un correcteur pénalise un devoir qui ne défend qu'un seul camp, même bien écrit, parce que la consigne demande explicitement une discussion, pas un plaidoyer à sens unique.

questions.enonce_markdown: **2.** Write a letter to your uncle thanking him for having bought your school needs and paid your school fees at the beginning of the academic year. Your name is Ndombolo Francis, and your school is G.B.S.S. Mbiniki, P.O. Box 2222, Mbiniki.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Une lettre personnelle (personal/friendly letter) suit une mise en page fixe : l'adresse de l'expéditeur et la date en haut à droite, la formule d'appel (« Dear... »), un corps de lettre organisé en paragraphes (motif de la lettre, développement, clôture du sujet), une formule de politesse finale et la signature. Le non-respect de cette structure est pénalisé même si le contenu est par ailleurs correct.

Modèle de lettre respectant cette structure, avec l'identité donnée par le sujet (Ndombolo Francis, G.B.S.S. Mbiniki, P.O. Box 2222, Mbiniki).

G.B.S.S. Mbiniki

P.O. Box 2222

Mbiniki

12th September, 2006

Dear Uncle,

I hope this letter finds you and the whole family in good health. I am writing to thank you sincerely for buying all my school needs and for paying my school fees at the beginning of this academic year.

Without your help, I would not have been able to start school on time this year, and I know how much sacrifice this must have cost you. Thanks to you, I already have all my textbooks and school materials, and I have been attending classes regularly since the first day of school. My teachers say I am doing well, especially in English and Mathematics, and I promise to work even harder to make you proud of me.

Once again, thank you very much, Uncle, for everything you do for me. May God bless you abundantly.

Your loving nephew,

Ndombolo Francis

### Piège à éviter
N'oublie jamais l'adresse de l'expéditeur, la date et la formule de politesse finale : une lettre au contenu parfait mais sans cette présentation reste sanctionnée en expression écrite anglaise.

Le non-respect de cette structure est pénalisé même si le contenu est par ailleurs correct.

questions.enonce_markdown: **3.** Why and how must people seek peaceful solutions to their problems? Give your reasons.
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un sujet qui pose une double question (« Why AND how... ? ») attend un développement qui traite explicitement les deux volets l'un après l'autre : d'abord les raisons (pourquoi c'est nécessaire), puis les moyens concrets (comment y parvenir), avant de conclure.

Modèle de composition d'environ 220 mots traitant successivement le « why » et le « how ».

**Introduction.** Conflicts are part of human life, whether between individuals, communities or nations. Yet how these conflicts are handled makes all the difference between lasting harm and genuine progress. This is why people must always seek peaceful solutions to their problems.

**Why (les raisons).** Violence never truly solves a problem; it only replaces it with new ones such as injuries, deaths, destroyed property and lasting hatred between the parties involved. A peaceful solution, on the other hand, allows both sides to keep their dignity and to continue living or working together afterwards. Furthermore, peace protects innocent people, especially children and the elderly, who suffer the most whenever violence breaks out.

**How (les moyens).** To seek peaceful solutions, people must first learn to communicate openly and listen to the other party's point of view instead of assuming they are entirely wrong. Dialogue, mediation by a trusted and neutral third person, and compromise, where both sides agree to give up something, are practical ways of settling disputes without violence. Education also plays a key role, as it teaches tolerance and respect for others from an early age.

**Conclusion.** Peaceful solutions demand more patience than violence, but they are the only ones that build lasting relationships and a safer society for everyone.

### Conseil
Quand un sujet pose deux questions liées par « and » (why AND how), consacre un paragraphe distinct à chacune : un correcteur vérifie que les deux volets de la consigne ont bien été traités, pas seulement l'un des deux.

rappels_de_methode.competence: Traiter une double consigne why/how dans un essai argumentatif
rappels_de_methode.contenu_markdown: Un sujet qui pose une double question (« Why AND how... ? ») attend un développement qui traite explicitement les deux volets l'un après l'autre : d'abord les raisons (pourquoi c'est nécessaire), puis les moyens concrets (comment y parvenir), avant de conclure.
